_readme: Umbraco major version support schedule, sourced from https://umbraco.com/products/knowledge-center/long-term-support-and-end-of-life/ (fetched 2026-08-15). Package major versions align with the Umbraco major they target. 'eol' is the date official Umbraco support ends for that major — once past, the versions page treats it as unsupported and hides it. Majors with no entry here are treated as supported (unknown/never expires). Majors 0-6 below cover pre-Umbraco-7 package versioning schemes (e.g. old uSync/Maintenance Mode majors that predate tracking Umbraco's own major number) — Umbraco's page states 'all versions earlier than Umbraco 7 are no longer supported', so these are marked long expired to drop off the versions page. Re-check this page periodically, especially the upcoming-release rows (19, 20, 21) once they actually ship.
